observations.overcast-sky: At variance .25, noticeable grain remains; nominal and4 look smooth and similar.
observations.building-detail: Increasing variance to4 suppresses thin diagonal beam details; lower variance retains grain.
observations.foliage: Variance4 visibly softens leaf edges and small structure; variance.25 retains grain.
observations.chain-link-fence: Variance4 softens crossings/diagonal wires and nearby vegetation; variance.25 is grainier.

qualitative_review.decision: Keep nominal input-only profile unchanged; higher conditioning removes detail without a broad visible benefit in these retained models. No new model, calibration claim, real-GT score, or full-frame quality/speed promotion.

scope: 24 fixed CPU FP32 forwards on four cached512 GFX contexts, V43/V63 existing EMA weights, shot and read both multiplied by variance factors1/.25/4 (standard deviations1/.5/2); no input/target fitting, changed weights, training, full-frame speed, calibration truth, real-GT score, promotion or protected-final scoring. Independently demosaiced ISO100 f5.6 reference differs in time/aperture/motion; native160px crops at common exposure4. Repeat nominal sky after profile switches and verify all model state bytes/keys/IDs. Pause CPU work after original training owner exits until exact owned review/timing owners and children exit.
limits: V43 and V63 differ in architecture, initialization and training budget; not a DINO ablation.
CPU FP32 context predictions, not the historical FP16 GPU/full-frame exports or a speed comparison.
Independent ISO100 f5.6 reference has different aperture/time/motion; no pixelwise GT score or noise calibration truth.
Sensitivity changes all supplied shot/read variances together; cannot identify which coefficient is wrong or establish either is wrong.
No change to production models, noise profiles, active training/review sources or README representative model.
